utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind on the details, but I’d love to hear what they picked. If you know the title, could you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure of the title yet, but I can check and let you know. I’m usually a little late anyway, so I’m happy to catch up once we’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks — I’d really appreciate that. I’m usually catching up late too, so just send me the title when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good to me—I'm in for next Tuesday at 7:30. Want me to help pick a lively novel?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds great, Mara — I’ll note next Tuesday at 7:30 and welcome any lively novel ideas.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can suggest a few lively novels and send them over soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Noah — just let me know what the book club needs, and I’ll be happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check what the book club needs and let you know. I might be a little scattered, but I appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, Noah — take your time, and just let me know when you’ve got the list. I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, please — I’d really appreciate the reminder. My brain’s a sieve today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll check with the group and remind you of the title again once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’m sorry, my brain’s been wandering off today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies while you and Rosa pick the book.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm, which book did Rosa pick? I want to make sure we’re all on the same one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t think Rosa has picked one yet — we were still narrowing it down. I’ll check in and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure you get the invite as soon as the next book club date is set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. I’ll keep you posted as soon as we lock in the date.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — as soon as you have the date, I’ll send it along and get everyone invited too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday at 7 by the community room works for me. We’re reading "The Midnight Library," and I’ll send the reminder later today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at 7 works for me too, and thanks for the reminder. I’m glad it’s just one read—please send the details later today so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the details later today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s been really nice so far—small group, good coffee, and a lot of surprisingly fun book talk. We’re just getting to know each other, but it already feels easy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great — could you send me the date, time, and the first book so I can make sure I’ve got the details right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the details and send you the date, time, and first book. I’m pretty sure it’s Thursday evening at the community center, so I’ll make sure I get the rest right.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — glad you’re here. Want to pick the book first, or settle the meeting time for book club?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Rosa — I’d be happy to settle the meeting time first, if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — let’s lock in the meeting time first, then we can pick the book. How does Thursday at 7 in the community room sound?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: So far it’s just the mystery and the lighter contemporary novel on the shortlist. The mystery seems to be edging ahead, if you want the quick scoop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good to me — the mystery does seem like the stronger pick. Thanks for the quick scoop, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out in case they make it official this week. If you want, I can tell you what the mystery’s about once they settle on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — once you’ve got the title, send it my way and I’ll handle the sign.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Mina. I’ll pick a title at the meeting and send it your way right after.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll wait for your message, then print the sign.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh right — I’m still checking the title, but I’m in for it. I’ll send the exact book as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — send it over when you find it, and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — I’ll check and send the title over soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure you get the invite as soon as I set the next book club date.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the book title too? I just want to make sure I’ve got the right one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet — I’m still lining up the next read, but I’ll send the title with the invite as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds lovely — I’m still tossing around a few title ideas, but I should have one by the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll check with the others and circle back once we’ve settled the book club pick.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll bring it up at the next meeting and let you know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — I’d appreciate that. No rush; I’m happy to hear what you need whenever you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re welcome, Rey. I’ll mention it at the next meeting and let you know what comes up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the date, time, and the first book first, then I’ll let you know. That should keep us on track for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — that sounds perfect. I’ll plan around 7:30 after pickup and wait for your update on the first book.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — I’ll confirm the date, time, and first book, then send you the details so you can plan around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still a little out of the loop, but I’d love the details if you’ve heard them. What are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a bit behind on the details too — I’ll check and send you the title as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too, and maybe we can compare notes once we know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice — a mystery sounds fun, and the community center on Thursday seems like a good, low-key meetup. I might swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, Thursday at the community center sounds easy enough — I’ll probably be a little late, but I’m still in. Let’s just confirm the time and which mystery we’re starting with.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check the exact time and the mystery title, and I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: We’re reading The Night Circus this month. Just text me when you’ve got the time confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — I’ll confirm the time once I’ve checked my schedule. If there’s any logistics to sort out, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — I’ll send over any logistics if I spot them. Just let me know once you’ve checked your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still going well — we’re reading a mystery and meeting at the community center on Maple Street this Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the title and a reminder later today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. See you Thursday evening at the Maple Street community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’d like that. Please do let me know when the next book club is set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set, and I can check the latest details too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still just those two: a buzzy mystery and a lighter contemporary novel. The mystery seems to be edging ahead, if you want the latest scoop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know — I’ll keep an eye out for the final pick and print the sign once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds perfect — I’ll let you know the minute they decide, and then you can print that sign.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m blanking again — let me check and I’ll tell you in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush — just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep an eye on the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll check and get back to you in a sec.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got tools and I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind. We’re aiming for a lively first novel and meeting next Tuesday at 7:30, so if you want to help with anything, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I can help with whatever you need for Tuesday, just let me know.
